description_en: Modifies the settings related to the automatic minor version update for an instance
description_zh: 修改实例的小版本自动升级开关
name: ModifyDBInstanceAutoUpgrade

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic minor version update. Valid values:

1: enables automatic minor version update.
0: disables automatic minor version update
parameters.help_zh:
小版本自动升级开关，取值：
1：开启。
0：关闭
parameters.name: value
